title: Sort Of "Useful"
text:
Sort Of "Useful". Since we are over run with squash right now I decided to try this noodle thing that everyone is talking about. I looked a t bunch of these spiral gadgets and decided, based on reviews, that I'd try this one.

Pros:
Works well doing zucchini and turning it into noodles
The blade storage is handy.

Cons:

Kind of bulky. Takes up a chunk of cabinet space.
No little "tabs" as stated on the box to help you disengage the suction cups. This sucker stuck to my granite countertop and wouldn't let lose.
The instructions are OK, but keep the box because that's the only place the blades are described by function

The quality is about what you would expect for the price. I expect it to last about as long as my fascination with veggie noodles.

features: Shredder: creates long, spaghetti-like spiral strands
Chipper: creates long, thick spiral strands
Straight: creates long, ribbon-like strands Use with a variety of fruits and vegetables including apples, potatoes, carrots, cucumber, zucchini and more

description: Useful. UH-A101 vegetable slicer creates spiral cuts and vegetable or fruit noodles in seconds. The frame and blade plates are constructed of very high-quality, impact-resistant ABS plastic that is BPA-free, and the blades are made of stainless steel. It has four powerful suction feet that are fitted with tabs for easy release, and does not require an outlet connection or batteries. The slicer is an easy-to-use, handy tool that makes zucchini spaghetti, cucumber ribbon strands, curly fries or long, spiral apple strands. It comes with three blades: a shredder blade (small holes), a chipper blade (large holes) and a straight blade. A storage compartment beneath the frame stores two blades and the third blade comes already in place. Key Features: Three stainless steel blades: Shredder: creates long, spaghetti-like spiral strands Chipper: creates long, thick spiral strands Straight: creates long, ribbon-like strands Use with a variety of fruits and vegetables including apples, potatoes, carrots, cucumber, zucchini and more Impact-resistant, BPA-free ABS plastic frame and blade plate construction Integrated storage compartment holds extra blades Powerful suction feet for stability with easy release tabs Hand operated--no batteries or AC outlet necessary Three Blades for Versatility The shredder blade measures 1/8", or 3mm, in thickness and produces long spaghetti-like spiral strands. The chipper blade measures 1/4", or 5mm, in thickness and produces long, thick spiral strands. The flat blade measures 1/8", or 3mm, and produces long ribbon-like strands.
